q2_gaps: an inceptive verb whose subject IS an event-denoting noun ('the war broke out', 'a fire broke out') - the light-verb-over-event-noun rule names only occur / happen / take place, so it is undecided whether to reify a separate event with the noun as Patient or put the tense and time atoms straight on the event-noun witness
a locative PP inside an NP modifying an event-denoting noun ('the war in Iraq') - the Location-vs-LocatedIn split is stated for events vs things, not for an event-noun modified inside its own NP
notes: 'ten years ago' matches the (BeforeBy e now n unit) pattern exactly, and break_out is kept surface-faithful with no genus and no single-word synonym. Patient on the intransitive change-of-state subject follows the subject test.
